name: Auto Insurance Live Transfers

hero.headline: Auto Insurance Live Transfers
hero.subheadline: Connect with high-intent consumers actively looking for auto insurance solutions.

overview: Auto Insurance Live Transfers are consumers qualified by our team and warm-transferred to your agents, generated by Altarious Global performance campaigns and delivered to your business in real time. Connect with drivers actively comparing auto insurance quotes and ready to speak with a licensed agent.

Live transfers add a qualification layer in front of the agent. Our team confirms the driver's state, vehicle, coverage status and interest in a quote before warm-transferring the call, so the agent spends time only with consumers who match the carrier's appetite. This is especially valuable for captive agents and carriers with strict underwriting guidelines, because the pre-screen removes out-of-footprint and non-qualifying drivers before they consume agent time.

This product is suited to insurance businesses with a team ready to answer during defined hours, a clear view of the consumer they want, and the capacity to convert a live conversation. The acquisition objective is simple: put your team in front of auto insurance consumers at the moment they are deciding.
targetConsumer: Licensed drivers aged 18 to 70 who own or lease at least one vehicle and are currently uninsured, approaching renewal, or dissatisfied with their premium. The strongest segments are households with multiple vehicles, recent movers, and drivers whose rates increased after a claim or ticket.
consumerIntent: Typical intent signals include: searching for auto insurance quotes or rate comparisons; renewal notice received with a premium increase; recently purchased, financed or leased a vehicle; moved to a new state or zip code.
howGenerated: Consumers are acquired through performance campaigns targeting searches such as "auto insurance quotes" and "cheap car insurance", plus social and comparison placements. Interested consumers speak with our qualification team before any transfer is attempted.
qualification: Qualification is configured to your appetite. Standard auto insurance criteria include: valid driver's license and vehicle to insure; located in a state the buyer is licensed to write; currently insured or uninsured status confirmed; interested in receiving a quote today; age 18 or older and the policy decision maker; not already a customer of the receiving carrier.
delivery: Once qualified, the consumer is bridged directly to your designated number or queue with a warm introduction. Delivery runs only during your operating hours with daily caps, and you can pause or adjust criteria at any time.

faq.q: Which states can auto insurance calls be targeted to?
faq.a: Campaigns can be filtered to the specific states and ZIP codes where your agency or carrier is licensed to write auto policies, so you only receive consumers you can actually quote.

faq.q: Can calls be filtered by coverage status?
faq.a: Yes. Programs can prioritise currently insured shoppers, uninsured drivers, or both, depending on your underwriting appetite and pricing strategy.

faq.q: What hours are auto insurance calls delivered?
faq.a: Delivery follows your operating schedule. Calls are routed only during the hours and days your licensed agents are available to answer, and routing can be paused or capped at any time.
